title: Know your exits
text: When you enter a busy hall, find the two nearest exits before the event starts. Look for the green exit signs. The exit you came through is not always the closest one.
alt_text: Green exit sign above a door

title: Move calmly and steadily
text: When the alarm sounds, walk steadily and keep to one side. Do not run, push or turn back against the crowd. A steady pace keeps everyone moving and prevents falls.

title: Help others safely
text: Offer help to people who need it, but do not stop in a doorway or block the exit. If someone cannot move quickly, stay close and call a member of staff for help.

title: Assembly point and headcount
text: Go to the assembly point and stay there. Do not go back inside for belongings. Tell staff if someone is missing and where you last saw them.
alt_text: Green sign marking an assembly point
